name: @cpangular/simple-theming-demo
description: Simple demonstration of ng-material-theme with light-dark() support

scripts.build: sass src/styles.scss dist/styles.css --load-path=../ng-material-theme && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp ../ng-material-theme/css/dist/core.css dist/core.css && cp ../ng-material-theme/css/dist/theme-switcher.js dist/theme-switcher.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && npx http-server dist -p 8080 -o
